svg.title: Bottlebrush flower — Callistemon-blóm
svg.desc: A long cylindrical bottlebrush bloom is represented by five levels of radiating stamens with small terminal anther outlines.
svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Sectors and Nature","subject":"flower-bottlebrush","label_en":"Bottlebrush flower","label_is":"Callistemon-blóm","section":"18","category_en":"Flowers, floral forms and floristry","category_is":"Blóm, blómgerðir og blómaskreytingar","batch":9,"tags":["botany","flower","callistemon"],"description":"A long cylindrical bottlebrush bloom is represented by five levels of radiating stamens with small terminal anther outlines.","design_note":"Sparse representative stamens preserve the bottlebrush structure without a dense fringe of tiny lines.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
